name: Animus

effects.name: Banishing Weapons
effects.tooltip: Banishing Weapons : While wearing this item, your melee and ranged weapons gain Vorpal Effect: In addition, on an attack roll of 20 which is confirmed as a critical hit this weapon will banish a creature from this plan of existence. Powerful creatures may resist the vorpal effect until sufficiently wounded.

effects.name: Taint of Evil
effects.tooltip: Taint of Evil : Good aligned characters equipping this item suffer a temporary negative level until the item is removed.

effects.name: Rune Arm Imbue : Fire
effects.tooltip: Rune Arm Imbue : Fire IV: Wearing this Rune Arm will imbue any weapon you wield, dealing 2d8 points of Fire damage per hit.

effects.name: Craftable Rune Arm
effects.tooltip: This Rune Arm is craftable and can be customized using recipes at standard crafting devices after disjuncting.

customisation_hints.raw: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4 and/or Mythic Shield Boost +2 or +4
customisation_hints.text: Weapon Boost +2 or +4 and/or Mythic Shield Boost +2 or +4

flavor_text: A lemure's spirit is trapped within this rune arm. The loathing it has for you is exceeded only by its hatred of your enemies.
notes: Drops on Normal and above for Heroic and Epic difficulties. Retains Banishing Weapons & Taint of Evil when disjuncted for Essence Crafting. Visual Disjuncted for Essence Crafting
